requirements.requirement: The system must define a typed frontend data schema for PI credibility that includes investigator_name as a string field.
The system must define institution as a string field within the PI credibility schema.
The system must define prior_trial_count as a numeric field within the PI credibility schema.
The system must define publication_indicator as a boolean field within the PI credibility schema.
The system must define score_contribution as a numeric field representing PI contribution to overall trial score.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with the expected payload structure from backend dependency EVAL-CT-MEASURE-PI.
The system must define all schema fields with explicit types to support TypeScript validation in the frontend.
The system must ensure the schema can be serialized into a format consumable by MessageBubble.tsx rendering pipeline.
The system must allow optional (nullable) values for institution when backend data is missing.
The system must allow optional (nullable) values for prior_trial_count when backend data is unavailable.
The system must default publication_indicator to false when the field is absent in backend payload.
The system must reject or flag schema mismatch if required field investigator_name is missing from backend payload.
The system must reject or flag schema mismatch if score_contribution is not a numeric value.
The system must ensure the schema supports extension without breaking existing fields for future PI metrics.
The system must document the schema in a shared interface or type definition accessible to all frontend components using PI data.
